metadata.title: Concierge.Ai fresh ECC acceptance ledger
metadata.source_matrix: audit/master-feature-acceptance.json (2026-10-13 audit snapshot; superseded for current status by this ledger)
metadata.verified_formula: 100 × (LOCALLY VERIFIED + LIVE VERIFIED) core rows / 384. No LIVE VERIFIED rows are claimed. R-X01 is deferred and excluded.

full_backend_local.failure_cause: Installer tests could not bind because a pre-existing local Python listener held port 8080; it was left running.

focused_wayfinding_backend.scope: tests/test_guest_entry.py, including signed property/node binding, published-map QR generation, guest start resolution, tampered signature rejection, cross-property rejection, and hidden-node denial

full_browser_nonvisual.scope: desktop Chromium and mobile Chrome; run after deterministic test-property cleanup fix and before QR UI addition

retention_race_browser.scope: six scenarios on Chromium and mobile Chromium

wayfinding_admin_browser.scope: Chromium generated an SVG QR and HTTPS signed URL for a published guest-visible waypoint

wayfinding_guest_browser.scope: Chromium desktop and mobile Chrome; QR query, published map rendering, default route origin, destination selection, gateway-context filtering, and new-chat continuity

visual_browser.scope: guest home and admin design; desktop/mobile

test_results.bandit: PASS — app scan at medium severity/confidence threshold
test_results.pip_audit: PASS — final requirements-dev manifest, including qrcode==8.2; no known vulnerabilities found.
test_results.npm_audit: PASS — zero high-level vulnerabilities on the unchanged base package manifests
test_results.current_worktree_gitleaks: PASS — Gitleaks 8.24.3 no-git redacted scan after QR changes: 0 findings. Hosted full-history secret scanning remains required.

github_base_ci.result: 9/10 jobs passed; secret-scan failed on three historical findings in audit/evidence/security-2026-10-12/recovery-harness-before.txt. No credential values are copied into this ledger.

github_candidate_ci.result: QUEUED at the initial draft PR head; a documentation-only head update is being prepared and will trigger the current candidate checks.

repository_release_controls.main_branch_protection: DISABLED; GitHub integration denied branch-protection configuration access (HTTP 403).
repository_release_controls.historical_secret_cleanup: Prepared and validated only in a disposable mirror; issuer-side revocation confirmation and owner authorization for shared-history rewrite remain outstanding.

external_blockers.action: Revoke the identified credential at its issuer, confirm revocation, then authorize coordinated history cleanup and re-run full-history Gitleaks.
Enable required checks on main: Backend, Browser, PostgreSQL/Redis, Docker, dependencies, static security, secret scan, Linux deployment, macOS deployment.
Validate QR/NFC, captive recovery, WLAN/AP placement, and published floor-plan accuracy on authorized iOS/Android devices and hotel hardware.
Approve the location-observation retention duration and deletion scope.
Provide authorized credentials/contracts and run live provider, checkout, WLAN, and outbound-notification checks.

metadata.release_recommendation: RED — RELEASE BLOCKED. Historical credential revocation/history cleanup and required branch protection remain unresolved, and several requirements remain partial, failed, or externally blocked.
